## Delivery checklist

Follow the canonical [delivery policy](https://github.com/jw29247/WhiskerFlow/blob/main/AGENTS.md#delivery-policy).

- [ ] Required checks and appropriate behavioural verification are complete.
- [ ] The single initial GitHub Codex PR review is complete (automatic preferred;
      request once only if none is completed, queued or running).
- [ ] Actionable findings and genuine defects in subsequent automatic feedback
      are addressed; repairs verified and required discussions clear.
- [ ] Merge/deployment authority and actual completion state are recorded.
